Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates patchy, ill-defined opacities in the right lower lung zone (right basal shadowing), which is characteristic of bronchopneumonia. In patients with Duchenne muscular dystrophy, weak cough and impaired clearance predispose them to aspiration and recurrent lower respiratory tract infections, making this the most likely cause of dyspnea and non-productive cough among the choices.
